divergences.what: Overlay defaults to the system's light block, not dark
divergences.why: Redlining floats over arbitrary host apps as a tool; light was chosen as the default on 2026-09-06. Dark stays available and is the system's identity, so nothing in the light block is restyled.

divergences.what: Brand assets (mark, glyph, wordmark, favicons, broadcast and instructional layers) are not adopted
divergences.why: Redlining is its own npm package with its own name. Only tokens, type, spacing, radii, shadows, motion and component specs are consumed.

divergences.what: Fonts resolve to system fallbacks unless the host app already loads Space Grotesk / Inter
divergences.why: PRD section 13: nothing leaves the machine. The canon's Google Fonts @import and the Montserrat @font-face are stripped from the vendored copy; the token fallback stacks apply.

gaps.what: Vendor tokens: copy canon tokens.css + tokens/theme.css + the non-body parts of tokens/base.css into packages/redlining/src/overlay/styles/, truncated at the broadcast seam, with a SOURCE comment carrying slug, version and date
gaps.trigger: pnpm scaffold and src/overlay/ exist (PRD section 11)

gaps.what: Shadow-root selector transform: :root becomes :host; [data-theme="light"], .light becomes :host([data-theme="light"]), :host(.light). Set data-theme="light" on the shadow host per D1
gaps.trigger: with G1; decide build step vs one-time rewrite at scaffold time

gaps.what: Font strategy: strip the @import and the Montserrat @font-face; document that Space Grotesk / Inter render only when the host loads them; consider a fonts option later (PRD section 17.2 pattern)

Port Button, IconButton, Tooltip, Toast, Dialog, ConfirmDialog, Badge, Textarea from canon components/{core,overlay}/*.jsx into src/overlay/ui/ as TSX. Tooltip, Dialog and Toast portal to document.body in the canon; in Redlining they must portal to the shadow root

Toolbar, numbered pins, hover badge, note popover and list panel have no canon component. Build on tokens: pins rounded-full on --color-accent-fill with --color-on-accent; hover outline 2px --color-border-focus; popover radius-xl, shadow-2, --color-background-overlay; list panel 320px on --color-background-elevated
Expose theme: 'light' | 'dark' on <Redlining />. Dark is the canon default and needs no extra tokens once G2 lands
gaps.trigger: after G2; PRD section 17.2 options table

gaps.what: Re-measure contrast for pin labels and hover badges. The canon's claims are measured on its own four surfaces; the overlay adds a fifth, the host page under a scrim

notes: Pre-code repo as of 2026-09-06. Adoption is a pointer; vendoring happens with the scaffold. The PRD names the owner as Frank (kpunkt); kpunkt is the other complete canon system, so if this assignment was a slip, change the system field.
